_comment: This is the only file a business owner needs to edit. The agent is TOLD these rules so it behaves sensibly, but the rules are ENFORCED in src/policy.js by ordinary code that runs after the model has chosen its arguments. A model that ignores, misreads or is talked out of the policy still cannot move money outside these limits.
plain_english: Refunds up to $250 go out automatically, as long as they are no more than 50% of what the customer actually paid and the payment is less than 60 days old.
Anything bigger than that waits for a human to approve it.
No more than $1,000 of automatic refunds in a single day. After that, everything waits for approval.
Payments older than 180 days are never refundable, by anyone, through Teller.
Invoices up to $10,000 can be created and sent automatically. Larger ones need approval.
Teller never sends money out of the account on its own. Every outgoing payment needs a human.
